# Addax Tower Office Space — Aegis Coworking (full)

> Aegis Coworking - ADGM rents office space on Level 38 of Addax Tower (Office 3812), Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction. Serviced private offices start from AED 4,500 per month, dedicated desks AED 1,150, flexi desks AED 1,000 and virtual offices from AED 292. Leases are ADGM-compliant and registered on AccessRP.

This site (addaxtower.online) is a one-page guide to renting office space in Addax Tower, published by Aegis Coworking, a business centre and space provider in Abu Dhabi Global Market. Main website: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae

Last Updated: 2026-10-07

- Location: Level 38, Office 3812, Addax Tower, Al Reem Island — inside ADGM (24.4989303, 54.4031693)

## Why rent office space in Addax Tower?

Addax Tower is on Al Reem Island inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction, so office space in Addax Tower gives a company a genuine ADGM business address. At Aegis Coworking on Level 38 you can rent a serviced private office from AED 4,500 a month or a desk from AED 1,000, with an ADGM-compliant lease registered on AccessRP.

An ADGM business address at Addax Tower with mail handling, for companies that need the address but not the desk.

1. Tour Level 38 — Visit Addax Tower Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, or take a WhatsApp video tour from anywhere.

5. Move in — Collect your access card. Your Addax Tower business address is live.

## Frequently asked questions

### How much is office space for rent in Addax Tower?

At Aegis Coworking on Level 38 of Addax Tower, a serviced private office starts from AED 4,500 per month, a dedicated desk is AED 1,150, a flexi desk AED 1,000 and a virtual office from AED 292 per month.

Read more: [Private office rent in ADGM: 2026 guide](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/private-office-rent-adgm-cost-what-to-expect-in-2026)

### Is Addax Tower in ADGM?

Yes. Addax Tower is on Al Reem Island, which is within the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) jurisdiction, so an office in Addax Tower gives you an ADGM business address.

Read more: [Is Al Reem Island part of ADGM?](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/is-al-reem-island-part-of-adgm)

### Where exactly is Aegis Coworking in Addax Tower?

On the 38th floor of Addax Tower, Office 3812, Al Reem Island, RT3, Abu Dhabi.

Read more: [Addax Tower ADGM for businesses](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/addax-tower-adgm-business-workspace)

### Do you provide an ADGM-compliant lease agreement?

Yes. Aegis is an ADGM-compliant lease agreement space provider: private offices and dedicated desks come with a lease registered on AccessRP that you can use for your ADGM licence application and renewals.

Read more: [How AccessRP lease registration works](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/accessrp-adgm-lease-registration)

### Are the offices furnished and serviced?

Yes. Every private office is fully furnished with ergonomic desks and chairs and lockable storage, with high-speed internet, utilities, cleaning and reception included in the monthly rent.

### How long is the lease?

Leases run from 12 to 36 months. You can upgrade to a larger office in Addax Tower as your team grows.

### Are there deposits or setup fees?

No deposit, no admin fees and no setup fees, with free registration. A one-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee applies to the dedicated desk, and ADGM government fees are separate.

### Is there coworking space in Addax Tower?

Yes. The coworking space at Aegis on Level 38 offers flexi desks from AED 1,000 per month and day passes from AED 100, with WiFi, coffee and the business lounge.

Read more: [Affordable coworking on Al Reem Island](https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/blog/affordable-coworking-al-reem-island-adgm)

### Can I use the office for my ADGM licence?

Yes. Private offices and dedicated desks include a registered ADGM business address for your licence application. FSRA-regulated firms usually need a private office.

### Do I get 24/7 access to Addax Tower?

Private office and dedicated desk members have secure 24/7 access, every day of the week.

### Can I book a meeting room in Addax Tower without renting an office?

Yes. Meeting rooms and the boardroom can be booked by the hour for client meetings in ADGM.

### How do I book a viewing?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +971 50 392 6316. Tours run Monday to Friday, 9 AM–6 PM, and we can send a video walkthrough if you are abroad.
